title: Sum of common divisors
prompt: Specification: For integers a, b >= 2, return the sum of every positive integer that divides both a and b. Four candidate implementations follow. Which candidate satisfies the specification for all valid inputs? Select one candidate.

evidence.title: Candidate executions against the test suite
evidence.body:
Each candidate was executed against the same test suite.

Test 1: assert sum(10,15) == 6
Test 2: assert sum(100,150) == 93
Test 3: assert sum(4,6) == 3
Test 4: assert sum(4,8) == 7

annotations.notes: Adapted from MBPP task_id 126. The original range omits min(a,b); the corrected candidate includes it, and the test (4,8) separates them.
